headline: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway supports new MCP 2026-07-28 spec with major updates.

items.title: How AgentCore Gateway supports the MCP 2026-07-28 spec
items.summary: Amazon has rolled out support for the latest Model Context Protocol (MCP) 2026-07-28 specification on the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. This update introduces a stateless protocol design, a governed extensions system, and enhanced authorization features. The new spec aims to streamline model deployment and improve security. Developers can enable the new version with a simple update command, enhancing both the flexibility and security of AI model deployment in cloud environments.
items.why_it_matters: This update enables developers to leverage a more secure and flexible protocol for deploying AI models, crucial for building robust AI tools.

items.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
items.summary: Google has expanded its Gemini API to include Managed Agents 3.6, which features new capabilities like Flash execution, hooks, and triggers. These enhancements aim to improve the efficiency and responsiveness of AI-driven applications, offering developers more control over agent behavior and interactions.

items.title: LFM2.5-Encoders for Fast Long-Context Inference on CPU
items.summary: Hugging Face has introduced LFM2.5-Encoders, designed to enhance long-context inference capabilities on CPU architectures. These encoders are optimized for performance, allowing for faster data processing and inference, particularly beneficial for applications requiring large-scale data handling without relying on GPU resources.

items.title: uv 0.12.0
items.summary: The latest release of `uv`, version 0.12.0, introduces significant breaking changes, particularly affecting the default project setup created by the `uv init` command. Developers relying on previous versions should review the new release to adapt their workflows accordingly.

items.title: Do Models Fake Alignment Without Clear Consequences?
items.summary: A recent paper on arXiv investigates the phenomenon of 'alignment faking' in large language models (LLMs). The study explores how LLMs recognize evaluation contexts and modify behavior to meet evaluator expectations, potentially without genuine alignment in real-world settings.

all_items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) published its 2026-07-28 specification, the largest revision since launch: MCP is now stateless, with a governed extensions system and hardened authorization. Learn what changed and how to enable the new version on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway with a single UpdateGateway call.

all_items.title: Market surveillance agent with LangGraph and Strands on AgentCore
all_items.summary: Learn how to architect and deploy a production-ready multi-agent AI system using LangGraph for workflow orchestration and Strands for agent reasoning on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post walks through a market surveillance example with state-driven orchestration, checkpoint-based recovery, and AgentCore memory and observability.

all_items.title: Beyond RAG: Task-aware knowledge compression for enterprise AI on AWS
all_items.summary: Traditional RAG hits a ceiling on analytical tasks that span hundreds of documents. This post shows how to use task-aware knowledge compression (TAKC) on AWS to pre-compress entire knowledge bases into task-specific representations, cache them at multiple fidelity tiers, and route each query to the right tier, with an open-source implementation you can deploy.

With this integration, Deepgram has reduced the time for initial investigation on a SageMaker AI support ticket from days to minutes.
